value-1.chars: WD-1 (§6 L130, PROPOSED; SCR-093/default): Given any SCR-093..095 frame, then one scope label (LIVE or DEMO) is shown and every total sits under it; SCR-096 has none (tags are global, 21:3379)

value-2.chars: WD-5 (§6 L134, PROPOSED; SCR-093/default): Given the list, then R and net P&L precede entry and exit, and the totals bar names its filter

value-3.chars: WD-9 (§6 L138, PROPOSED; SCR-094/default): Given a group trade, then the list shows one row per account and SCR-094 lists the siblings

value-4.chars: WD-12 (§6 L141, PROPOSED; SCR-093/default): Given SCR-093's header, then "Manage tags" opens the modal and a row opens the page, not a drawer

value-5.chars: Columns: time (UTC), symbol, side, R, net P&L, entry, exit, qty, account, tags (WD-5 order); `14` checklist columns open time, fees, environment and rating are not drawn on the lo-fi row (fees on SCR-094; environment is the scope) — E41-D02 #1018 places them
